s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic illness with generalized weakness, weight loss, and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Renal involvement with proteinuria and hematuria
key_facts: Six months of progressive generalized weakness
Noncompliant with hypertension medication for over three years
Dullness to percussion and decreased breath sounds at the left lung base
Blood urea nitrogen 60 mg/dL, creatinine 1.69 mg/dL
Chest radiography showed bilateral pleural effusions
High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies
Urinalysis showed pH 5, 16 WBCs and 27 RBCs per high-power field

differentials: Multicentric Carcinoma of the Lymph Nodes
per_call: Multicentric Carcinoma of the Lymph Nodes

shortlist.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies, with low complement C3 levels, and multi-organ involvement

shortlist.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Mucosal pallor, non-tender lymphadenopathy, and potential renal involvement

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute inflammatory arthritis of the elbows and knees, and potential systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral pleural effusions, lymphadenopathy, and potential multi-organ involvement

shortlist.label: Wegener's Granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Renal involvement, and potential pulmonary and systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including progressive generalized weakness, weight loss, dyspnea, mucosal pallor, lymphadenopathy, and pleural effusions, along with laboratory findings such as high titers of ANA, anti-double-stranded DNA, and anti-Smith antibodies, low complement C3 levels, and urinalysis showing proteinuria and hematuria, are consistent with a diagnosis of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE). The presence of multiple systemic manifestations, including renal, hematologic, and pulmonary involvement, further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of symptoms such as dry eyes and dry mouth, which are typical of Sjögren's Syndrome

rejected.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
rejected.why: Absence of joint deformities and morning stiffness, which are characteristic of Rheumatoid Arthritis

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Negative tuberculin skin testing and lack of granulomatous inflammation on lymph node biopsy

rejected.label: Wegener's Granulomatosis
rejected.why: Absence of granulomatous inflammation and vasculitis on biopsy, which are hallmarks of Wegener's Granulomatosis
